issue_context.title: MQTT Integration no longer shows devices/entities
issue_context.body: ### The problem While all entities are available to the system, and work as expected. This is a copy of a [frontend issue](https://github.com/home-assistant/frontend/issues/13586), which I believed this to be atfirst. However, somehow this feels like being a core issue really, so posting the same info here. posted on[ #beta channel Discord](https://discord.com/channels/330944238910963714/427516175237382144/1015965423252021388 ) ### Describe the behavior you expected ![unknown](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/33354141/188393799-48cf547f-4801-40fe-8104-af345fe28a1d.png) ### Steps to reproduce the issue 1. updated to 2022.9.b0 2. lost panel info 3. downgraded to 2022.8.7 and still nothing.... ... ### Additional information as staccato described above, the panel lost its info after updating to the current beta 2022.9 cycle. also, only MQTT panel displays this issue, all other panels have the correct info. Ive done all I can think of: cleared cache x times reload integration disable/enable integration stopped/restarted add-on deleted/re-installed integration rebooted host downgraded to 2208.7 updated OS to version 8.5 Meanwhile update to 2022.9.2, and the issue persists ### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? 2022.9.0bx ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? 2022.8 ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant OS ### Integration causing the issue MQTT ### Link to integration documentation on our website https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/mqtt/ ### Diagnostics information [config_entry-mqtt-cf92f6e0a76e89abc790a6990c7f35bf.json.txt](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/files/9557522/config_entry-mqtt-cf92f6e0a76e89abc790a6990c7f35bf.json.txt) ### Example YAML snippet _No response_ ### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us? _No response_ ### Additional information _No response_
